newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby union-Ieremia returns, studies rivals.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Ieremia returns, studies rivals.

text.p: WELLINGTON, June 30 - Wellington midfield back Alama Ieremia was doing some overdue homework last night after missing television coverage of Saturday night's test matches.
Ieremia, who has returned to the All Black squad for next Saturday's Bledisloe Cup match in Christchurch, was celebrating his Wests club coach Ellis Meachen's birthday.
Ieremia gained his squad spot after a strong effort in Wests' 42-8 win over Harlequins at Athletic Park. All Black coach John Hart had a "spy" there noting Ieremia's performance.
"I knew I had someone watching me, but I didn't know who," Ieremia said.
"But the knee and shoulder both came through, I put in some big tackles and made some good runs. It's always good to hear the name read out."
Ieremia didn't find out how his All Black team-mates did until he turned on a video of the match yesterday.
"We were at a surprise function for our coach's birthday. So I've got some hard watching to do. I didn't see the Australia-France test either.
"It's important to watch all these games closely."
